captions.detailed: This 3D model represents a short, squat wide-angle zoom lens. It features a matte black outer barrel with a textured, ribbed focus ring on the lower section, a ribbed zoom ring on the upper section, and a blue-tinted glass lens element at the front. The zoom ring is designed with a revolute joint, allowing it to rotate and mechanically drive the extending inner barrel of the lens.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a short, wide-angle zoom lens. It should feature a matte black barrel with a ribbed focus ring, a rotating zoom ring, and a blue glass front lens element, incorporating a revolute joint to simulate the zoom ring articulation.
captions.factory: The model is constructed by creating cylindrical primitives for the main lens body sections. The ribbed textures on the focus and zoom rings are generated by repeating small subtractive cuts or additive patterns around the cylindrical perimeters. A revolute joint is defined to connect the rotating zoom ring to the main barrel, while a glass-like material with a blue tint is applied to a flat cylinder representing the front lens element.
